name: Birdwatcher Brigid

intro.text: Shh! A peregrine falcon nests on the crags above Slieve Binnian. If I don't see it today I'll be unbearable.

win: A fair fight, and I didn't even miss the falcon. Mostly.
after: The peregrine drops at over 300 kilometres an hour. It's the fastest animal on Earth. I can barely get the lid off my flask.
